channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Rob Dillingham | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Rob Dillingham from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Rob Dillingham
item.description:
Anthony Edwards on Rob Dillingham:

“He fire. Everybody know it. The world know it. It just takes time. It’s going to happen.... We been missing him the last couple weeks. He just got back out there and showed why he should be playing.”

Anthony Edwards on Rob Dillingham, Jan 18, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Rob Dillingham
item.description:
Connelly on Dillingham:

“Our eyes just kept getting drawn to Rob. We were calling all around, seeing if we could get something done. We weren’t too optimistic when the night started and we were lucky enough to obtain a pick and get a kid we think can really help us.”

Tim Connelly on Rob Dillingham, Jun 27, 2024. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: Rich Paul on Bronny James, Justin Edwards, Terrence Shannon, Rob Dillingham, Oso Ighodaro
item.description:
“But for me in my position, I’m just trying to find the best opportunity, whether it’s for Bronny, whether it’s for Rob Dillingham, whether it’s for Terrence Shannon, or Justin Edwards, or KJ Simpson, or Oso Ighodaro. Any [Klutch] guys in our class. That’s the draft.”

Rich Paul on Bronny James, Justin Edwards, Terrence Shannon, Rob Dillingham, Oso Ighodaro, Jun 20, 2024. Source: The Ringer.
